visual.general_description: Four-panel (A-D) bone marrow smear microscopy with colored arrows marking lymphoid cells, smudge cells and granulated mast cells.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 grid of purple and pink stained cytology smear fields, each with a panel letter in a white box at its upper left and a scale bar labelled "x 1000" and "20 uM" at the lower right. Round lymphoid cells with purple nuclei fill every panel. Red arrows mark dark purple or pink-purple granulated clumps or cells (A one, B two, C one, D two), white arrows mark pale-cytoplasm cells (A one, B one, C one, D two), black arrows mark small dark cells (A, C and D one each), and two yellow arrows in panel C mark smudged ruptured nuclei. No identifiers, text beyond the labels, or faces are visible.

panels.general_description: Bone marrow smear field of purple-stained round lymphoid cells with one clump of dark purple granules at upper left of center; one red, one white and one black arrow are present.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A (letter in a white box at upper left) shows a cytology smear with many round cells with purple nuclei and thin pale cytoplasm. A red arrow at the upper left points at a clump of dark purple-blue granules. A white arrow right of center points at a cell. A black arrow at the lower left of center points at a small dark-nucleus cell. Pink-white background with faint pink dots. A scale bar at the lower right is labelled "x 1000" and "20 uM". No identifiers are visible.

visual.general_description: Literature summary table of SM-CLL case reports with two final rows for the present case.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background table with a blue header row and twelve columns: Ref, N, Diagnosis (year), Tryptase ng/mL, SM symptoms, CD2+ MC, CD25+ MC, CD30+ MC, Biology, CLL therapy, SM therapy, Outcome. Rows for references 2 (two rows), 3, 4, 5 (two rows) and 6 list literature cases with diagnoses and years, tryptase values, symptoms, mast-cell marker Yes/No/NA entries, biology, therapies and outcomes. The last block labelled Our case has two rows (ISM 2014 and SSM + high-risk CLL 2023/2024) with a merged Outcome cell reading CLL: PR, SM: PR, No more symptoms. A footnote paragraph below states that data from the present case are included, that SM generally precedes CLL/SLL diagnosis, that this is the only case reporting a more significant therapeutic outcome (partial remission) and defines abbreviations. No patient photograph, face or identifier is visible.
